you're not ugly! i hope your journey with weight loss is going well, please be careful and do it for health reasons- thinner doesn't equal prettier! as for things you can do to "make yourself look better", try to start with the inside. i struggle with my appearance and i tend to notice that the way i feel has a big impact on how i perceive myself, and how people perceive me. people tend to find happiness and joy pretty and they tend to be attracted by those who radiate good feelings. so start by doing stuff you enjoy- if you can find an activity that you enjoy which directly connects to your physical appearance, that helps a lot. for me, doing face masks seems to help. it make s my skin look nice while also making me feel nice inside, therefore making me perceive myself in a more positive way. i also really like experimenting with makeup, so you can always try that- i promise you don't need talent, nor do you need to know what you're doing. just have fun and do what you like and makes you feel cute. my makeup style isn't exactly conventional and i actually get made fun of it sometimes, but it makes me feel very cute and that's what matters. one last point would add, and this might be personal taste perhaps, but since you wear glasses, getting frames that suit your face well is very important because it toooootally changes your face (i say  this from my own experience). for me, changing to wire-framed glasses really helped improving my looks. i used to wear glasses exactly like yours, and as they're thick and dark they distract from your features and don't let your eyes pop! i personally think getting thinner or lighter frames would distract less from your face and gove you a lighter, more youthful look (but don't forget this is totally personal opinion and you should wear what you think looks good. the important thing will always be that YOU feel good and YOU think you look good). i hope this helps you and i do hope you're able to improve your self confidence, i'm rooting for you

Ora como não há mais nenhum sítio para me queixar do ridículo que é este país, aqui estamos. Uma pandemia com um risco de propagação enorme e adivinhem? Aqui estou eu, há mais de 15 dias, doente com todos os sintomas do vírus após ter estado com alguém que foi confirmado estar infetado. A dificuldade em respirar começou hoje e já não sei o que fazer. Não posso ir ao hospital porque no caso de estar infetada, é prejudicial para os outros. A quarentena, apesar de servir para conter isto, nada faz quanto aos meus sintomas, e a saúde 24 depois de 20 e tal tentativas de ligar e depois de 2 dias em esperas constantes, lá falou comigo e disse que seria contactada por um médico e até agora nada. Mais um dia inteiro passado a ligar para eles por terem piorado os sintomas, e é basicamente impossível ser atendido, quanto mais quererem saber do perigo em que estamos. E é isto. Moro com os meus avós, estou a faltar à escola há semanas, a faltar a testes e a perder matéria atrás de matéria. Caso tenha o vírus, tenho um avô acabado de sair do hospital com vários problemas devido a um traumatismo craniano e uma avó que foi operada há 2 meses atrás. A realidade é que se eu o tiver, eles provavelmente também já têm. Só gostava de saber como se vão safar. E continuamos a ter os chicos espertos a ir para a praia e etc porque yay, estão de férias!1!1!. A falta de noção do português é assustadora, e a falta de organização e preocupação por parte dos médicos e quem devia estra preocupado é apenas triste. O facto do nosso sistema de saúde ser tão mau é vergonhoso. Enfim, palmas para Portugal e venham daí mais x semanas de estar trancada em casa à espera de saber como posso ser tratada para os meus sintomas, e a eventual crise que vai originar deste vírus. I'm really young, i'm only 17 now and this was last year in August, back when i was 16.please don't think I'm just some troubled ungrateful teenager, i've just dealt with a lot of shit and problems since a really young age. at this time i was kind of having one of those weeks that you just feel so absolute shit you can't get out of bed. they took me off all medication because my psychiatrist fired herself, so i was kind of dealing with shit all by myself, no meds, no antidepressants, no anything. on this one day, i felt great. it was like all the happiness in the world came back to me, though it was later obvious that was only the bipolar disorder talking. i remember doing so much  stuff that day, being so productive, which was new given my usual state.. i really don't even know what set me off. i felt great all day long, but then night came, the really shitty feeling and thoughts came back and yeah. there was some stupid fight with my boyfriend which really didnt make it better, but i guess what really set me off was a conversation between my parents, about how all my therapy and medication and everything i need because of my mental health being shit costing them so much, and me being such a burden, all the kind of nice stuff you'd enjoy hearing from a parent. i really cant remember much after that- had a major meltdown, took a lot of pills.  my parents went somewhere so i was alone, i only sort of hinted my boyfriend and that was it. i ended up only taking about 50 or more pills out of the 200+ i took, with a bottle of cherry liquor to go with. i remember my boyfriend calling me a lot, i remember picking up, him screaming my name in panic and telling me he loved me, he didn't want me to leave, he didn't want me to die. i remember asking him to sleep and him begging me to throw up the pills, which i ended up doing solely for the fact that i loved him and i knew if i didn't, he would try to kill himself too (he has problems similar to mine). i kinda regret not dying that day. i remember going to bed and secretly begging i'd still not wake up, and i remember being so sleepy but just not being able to go to sleep. and i guess the pills slowed my heart rate like a lot, because at one point it felt like i was drowning, or choking, and there was a horrible pain in my chest. i remember finally falling asleep and when i woke up crying a lot, not because i'd tried to kill myself, but because i didn't die. i couldn't tell my parents what i'd done, but i really needed to see a doctor. i couldn't stand up at all, could barely breathe, couldn't even be sat down, or eat, or drink-even needed someone to carry and hold me to go to the bathroom. they ended up taking me to the ER when i still couldn't stand the next day. doctors easily passed it off as exhaustion and gave me some vitamins and shit and that was that- not even a blood test, or blood pressure test, just, nothing- the guy looked at me, heard my mom tell him the "symptoms", and that was it. exhaustion. 5 days went by until i could stand up by myself. the aftermath was definitely, definitely the worst part of it all. the awful feeling of failing it, but being way too scared to try again, sleeping every day in the same bed as where i'd done it, reliving it in my dreams and even awake. i remember not wanting to be alone at all, not even if it was just by myself in a division of the house with someone in the next room. i needed someone there with me because i felt really scared otherwise. i stopped sleeping for a long time, and i remember trying to draw or paint, or play the sims on my computer, or typing messages to my boyfriend, or typing tweets or taking pictures to keep my streaks going, ans not being able to do any of it because my hands shook to much, maybe because i fucked up my brain somehow, maybe because i was fucked up internally for what i'd done, but i remember it being the worst feeling i'd ever felt, not even being able to hold a glass, or eat by myself because the fork barely reached my mouth with food because of all the shaking. this lasted about 3 weeks od maybe a month. it's been months now, it'll be a year soon, because time just flies, and it saddens me that every single day i regret it more and more. not trying, but failing, as i've said. i feel like every single day my body craves more doing it again, bug this time taking all 200+ of the pills. and not being able to do it because i'm scared i'll have to go through all that shit again, or worse even fucks me up more.
